verdict.rationale: Daytona documents programmatic sandbox management through SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server, plus Computer Use for GUI automation. These are developer building blocks and one-off execution primitives, not a product feature for setting up automations that run on their own. The evidence shows no scheduler, recurring jobs, triggers or background automation configuration. Since sandbox infrastructure could plausibly ship such a feature, the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
